proposed_facts.reason: Independently read every cited range. EnterResting selects RESTING; falling and airborne collision pass it as a continuation. INFLIGHT decrements its remaining timer and calls Settle, which enters ACTIVE. The proposed correction agrees with functionality.md and does not depend on rendered names.

contradictions.reason: Accept the RESTING game-mapping correction and defer the other inaccurate RESTING/AIRBORNE suspension explanations, including both disputed links. Header state 4 is AIRBORNE, while timed settlement selects ACTIVE, state 5; inert AIRBORNE physics does not prove globally suspended motion. Supported callback relationships and endpoint membership remain retained.

Accept all eight section-related deferrals. Seven initializer entries and source arithmetic are visible, but they cannot establish compiled allocation, entry byte sizes, assertion-string pools, scalar-pool contents, or exclusive consumers. The vertical contact adjustment explicitly reads shared attributes rather than proving a local .sdata2 source.

Accept initialization and settlement deferrals: ordinary Spawned clears seven local fields but does not initialize lifetime. Settle loads lifetime and clears X/Y specifically. Joint spawning settles immediately after marking the instance stage-fixed; therefore universal timed-newly-created or all-component velocity claims exceed the implementation.

Accept both lifetime-ordering deferrals. Positive cooldown reaches zero before refresh; non-stage-fixed lifetime is decremented and expiration returns true before the warning helper. That helper receives the object, not the timer. Stage-fixed exemption is local, not proof of immunity from every destruction path.

Accept every contact-family deferral for Clanked, DmgDealt, HitShield and Repel. Their threshold is remaining flight duration >=6, not elapsed frame six. Settled callbacks set cooldown and spin; xC38 is supplied as the signed kind argument. Repel compares that argument to Flipper kind and changes this Flipper's own planar velocity away from the supplied position. It neither takes xC38 as a contact object nor explicitly pushes fighters. Stage-fixed exclusion occurs in callers. These shared observations reconcile all disputed contact-purpose, data-flow, temporal and gameplay explanations without silently retaining the erroneous wording.
